headline: War 140 Day Three: Heavy Fighting Rages Across Central Fronts
war_summary: Three days into War 140, the conflict has crystallized into a brutal struggle along a central corridor stretching from the Dead Lands through the Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, and Endless Shore. These four regions alone account for the vast majority of the war's violence, with combined casualties exceeding 15,000 and ownership of their 45 strategic bases split nearly evenly between Wardens and Colonials. The Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast saw the most recent base exchanges within the last hour, while the Dead Lands and Endless Shore remain hotly contested with five and ten captures respectively over the past day. To the north, Clahstra and Linn Mercy have emerged as significant secondary flashpoints, each recording nine or more base changes and over 1,000 casualties per side. Kingscage and the Fingers also saw sharp casualty acceleration and base captures. Meanwhile, the frontiers remain largely static: Colonials hold the western and southern arcs from Acrithia to the Umbral Wildwood, while Wardens control the northern and eastern reaches from Basin Sionnach to the Weathered Expanse. Enlistment rates are cooling universally, suggesting the initial mobilization has settled into sustained combat on established lines.
